# spokes-api/types/v1/hash_algorithm.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.v1.HashAlgorithm"></a>

### HashAlgorithm
HashAlgorithm encapsulates the possible hash algorithms for a repository.

| Name | Number | Description |
| ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| HASH_ALGORITHM_INVALID | 0 | HASH_ALGORITHM_INVALID indicates an invalid hash algorithm. |
| HASH_ALGORITHM_SHA1 | 1 | HASH_ALGORITHM_SHA1 indicates the SHA-1 hash algorithm. |
| HASH_ALGORITHM_SHA256 | 2 | HASH_ALGORITHM_SHA256 indicates the SHA-256 hash algorithm. |
